stories.title: Bono, Bruce Springsteen, and Cat Power Remember Glen Hansard
stories.summary: The Mountain Goats, Warren Ellis, Chris O’Dowd, and many others also paid tribute to the late Irish musician and Once star
stories.extract:
The music world is mourning Glen Hansard, the Irish singer-songwriter and Frames frontman who died this morning in a motorcycle crash at the age of 56. Bono, Bruce Springsteen, Cat Power, the Mountain Goats, Warren Ellis, and Courtney Marie Andrews were among those to write tributes on social media.

stories.title: Our verdict on Claire North’s space opera Slow Gods: a big thumbs-up
stories.summary: There was unusual consensus amongst New Scientist Book Club members about our read for July, with readers falling over themselves to praise this big-concept slice of science fiction
stories.extract:
The New Scientist Book Club has spent July reading Claire North’s space opera Slow Gods. Set in the far future, it follows the fortunes of a civilisation that has just learned that their planet will be destroyed by a supernova – in 100 years’ time.

stories.title: Why I can’t stop listening to the playlist for Artemis II’s astronauts
stories.summary: For years, NASA has woken its space-bound astronauts with playlists chosen from classics of the time. The musical line-up was a bit different for the Artemis II crew – and it’s a delight
stories.extract:
Most people have experienced the disorientation of waking up and not knowing where they are.
So, imagine how it must be to open your eyes in a location that rivals anything conjured in a dream: the inside of the tiny Orion capsule where you are a member of an Artemis crew. Oh, and also, the moon outside is disconcertingly large.

stories.extract:
